files.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a photorealistic premium apparel catalog sheet, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, four complete garments in an exact 2-by-2 grid. Reference image is a PRINT ART BOARD, not a garment. Top row: Camiseta preta, FRONT LEFT and BACK RIGHT of the SAME piece. Bottom row: Camiseta branca, FRONT LEFT and BACK RIGHT of the SAME second piece. Each row exactly centered at 25% and 75% canvas height; all garments fully visible with generous space. Neutral light gray seamless studio, diffuse side light, realistic cotton weave, stitching, hems, natural restrained folds, refined Nude Project/Coinbase shop product photography. Regular-fit crewneck T-shirts ONLY. Normal set-in shoulder exactly at shoulder edge, sleeves halfway upper arm, straight standard-length torso, approx52cm width/72cm length, no oversize, no boxy dropped shoulder, no crop or longline. Front of EACH garment: ONLY the small 3cm circular S shown at LEFT of reference board, positioned wearer's LEFT chest (viewer right). Preserve the exact white circle with negative S on black fabric or black circle with negative S on white fabric. No front slogan, no front wordmark. Back of top garment: exact art from top right of reference, text "If you see me in public, it’s AI."; back of bottom garment: exact art from bottom right, "Superintelligence". Preserve original typography, line breaks and little SNPS SI wordmark. Back artwork about28cm wide, upper-back centered; small SNPS SI underneath. Both views same color, same cut and size. No Portuguese instruction labels, no captions, no human/model/mannequin/hanger, no brand footer, no extra shapes or words, no watermark. The reference art must wrap naturally to fabric, not float. High photographic realism.
